articles.title: This Tiny Blob Sets a New Record for Hottest Life on Earth
articles.summary: Scientists found a new amoeba in a California volcano park that thrives at 145°F — hotter than any other complex life. It's called the 'fire amoeba from the Cascades.'

articles.title: Who Will Win Game of the Year? Here's the Inside Scoop
articles.summary: The Game Awards are coming Dec. 10, and experts think Resident Evil Requiem is the front-runner. But a new Fire Emblem game and a James Bond adventure are close behind.

articles.title: This Country Song Just Broke a Huge Chart Record
articles.summary: Ella Langley's 'Choosin' Texas' has spent 23 weeks at No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100, beating Mariah Carey's Christmas classic. Here's why it's so hard to knock off.
